name: web-wavsep
description: WAVSEP (Web Application Vulnerability Scanner Evaluation Project) — the neutral DAST leaderboard. Full 1,133-case ground truth bundled in expected-cases.csv. Deploy the WAVSEP webapp (zaproxy/wavsep, port 8080) and run via `tsbench wavsep --target <url> --ground-truth fixtures/web/wavsep/expected-cases.csv`. Score per-class Youden against WAVSEP's vulnerable + false-positive test cases.

competitors.note: Per-class Youden index (sensitivity + specificity - 1) across WAVSEP test cases. Requires the WAVSEP webapp deployed and reachable from the sandbox; this stub records the competitor numbers so the comparison is ready when the corpus is wired.

sampling_note: A CAPPED RUN MUST TARGET THE CATEGORY ROOTS, NOT THE CORPUS ROOT. TSENGINE_FANOUT_MAX_URLS caps the crawl in crawl order, and the crawler enters DOM-XSS first — so a cap-15 run scored 15 of 1133 cases and every XSS case it reached was DOM-XSS, which is 4 of the corpus's 1133 (0.35%) and the one XSS subset needing JS execution. The resulting 'xss 0%' generalised the hardest 0.35% to the whole class. Scan each root above separately with a per-category cap to get a balanced slice; the distribution is recorded here so the hazard is checkable rather than a general warning. Note LFI alone is 73% of the corpus, so an overall Youden is dominated by it.
